title: Rep. Gilbert Cisneros Disclosed 39 Stock Trades: 22 Purchases and 17 Sales

Transaction dates: Oct 14 to Nov 2, 2026 (20 of the 39 lines are dated Oct 20). Disclosure date: Nov 10, 2026 (8 to 27 days later). Member: Rep. Gilbert Cisneros, CA-31 (House). This is his second large filing in a month; see our post on the 19 transactions disclosed October 12.

What's been disclosed

  • Largest line: a purchase of Mobility Global (MBGL) in the $50,001–$100,000 band on October 15. A second large line is an Applovin (APP) sale of $15,001–$50,000 on October 14.
  • Purchases (22): including Eli Lilly (LLY), Cisco (CSCO), ServiceNow (NOW), Wells Fargo (WFC), Norwegian Cruise Line (NCLH), Lumentum (LITE), ON Semiconductor (ON), MACOM (MTSI) and BridgeBio (BBIO), mostly on October 20.
  • Sales (17): including Nvidia (NVDA), Uber, The Trade Desk (TTD), Chipotle (CMG), Ciena (CIEN), Illumina (ILMN) and Applovin (APP), plus two Lantheus (LNTH) lines and two Tokyo Electron (TOELF) lines.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts StandardAero (SARO) about 45% higher on November 11 than at purchase, Norwegian Cruise Line about 20% higher and Eli Lilly about 12% higher, while ServiceNow is about 33% lower, Lumentum about 21% lower and FIS about 17% lower. Among sales, Nvidia is about 20% lower than at the sale date and Applovin about 49% to 54% higher.
  • Timing: the filing came 8 to 27 days after the trades, inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
8 to 27 days after the trades, which were dated October 14 to November 2. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 11 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
